description: List Medium topics from the official directory at https://medium.com/explore-topics. Without a query, returns all topics grouped by category (Life, Work, Technology, etc.). With --query, uses the page's autocomplete to find matching topics by name. Each topic includes its slug for use with medium/get-topic-trending and medium/get-topic-info. No login required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional topic name to search for via the directory's autocomplete (e.g. 'artificial' matches 'Artificial Intelligence'). Omit to get the full categorized directory.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of topics to return (1-500). In directory mode (no query) the default is all topics. In query mode the default is 20.
